name: @domainspec-v2/cli
description: Private candidate for the DomainSpec v2 stable foundation CLI.

scripts.typecheck: npm run catalog:check && npm run relationships:check && npm run integration-profile:check && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit --pretty false
scripts.build: npm run catalog:check && npm run relationships:check && npm run integration-profile:check && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: node --import tsx --test test/cli/main.test.ts test/conformance/observe-target.test.ts test/generation/plan-instantiation.test.ts test/generation/publish-instantiation.test.ts test/input/operation-relationships.test.ts test/input/project-model.test.ts test/input/project-root.test.ts test/meta-types/catalog.test.ts test/system-integration/profile.test.ts
